summary: Tested new Inscrições (applications) and Produtos do club features end-to-end (API + UI desktop + mobile 390px) plus regression of iteration-1 suite. Backend 30/31 pass (only failure: deadline not enforced server-side). UI: join form (hero/contact links, yes/no validation, styles, success, duplicate error), admin approve -> temp password -> new member login lands on /membro, reject with note -> Recusadas, delete, product create (image upload)/edit/hidden/expired, member size/qty/Quero/Não quero, Ver respostas totals by size - all working. One mobile layout bug: member area horizontal overflow at 390px.

minor.issue: Deadline not enforced server-side: member can still respond via API to a product whose deadline is past (UI only hides buttons). Add check: if p.deadline and p.deadline < today -> 400 'Prazo encerrado'.
Does not delete the member's product_orders -> orphaned responses still counted in product totals (shown as '—' name). Add db.product_orders.delete_many({'user_id': mid}).
Concurrent double approve could raise DuplicateKeyError (500) on users.email unique index; use conditional update_one({_id, status:'pending'}) first or catch DuplicateKeyError.
No format validation for deadline (YYYY-MM-DD) and no max_length on reject note.

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal overflow: document scrollWidth=410 at 390px viewport. Root cause: TabsList (3 whitespace-nowrap tabs: Eventos & Encontros / Produtos do club / Meu perfil) is inline-flex ~400px wide and expands the single grid column (grid items min-width:auto), so member-id-card and member-dues-panel also overflow to 410px. Fix: add min-w-0 to grid children and make TabsList 'w-full overflow-x-auto' or 'flex-wrap h-auto', or shorten labels on mobile.

issues: Deadline uses native <input type='date'> browser picker instead of shadcn Calendar/Popover
Products without image show a large empty dark box; member view shows a ShoppingBag placeholder — use same placeholder in admin card

action_items: Fix member area horizontal overflow at 390px (TabsList width / grid min-w-0)
Delete product_orders when a member is deleted
Optional: guard approve against race (conditional update / catch DuplicateKeyError); validate deadline format; replace native date input with shadcn calendar
critical_code_review_comments: respond_product trusts UI for deadline; business rule must live on backend
delete_member leaves orphan product_orders (and approved application keeps user_id pointing to deleted user - acceptable)
ProductsList filters p.active client-side - redundant for members (backend already filters) but hides inactive products from admin when admin visits /membro; fine
ResponsesDialog table rows keyed by email; orphaned rows have empty email -> duplicate React keys possible
seed_data_creation: All TEST_ applications, members, products and product_orders deleted after testing (verified counts 0).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_applications_products.py covers applications RBAC/validation/duplicate/approve/reject/reapply/delete and products CRUD/hidden/responses/by_size; test_expired_deadline_response_backend currently fails by design until backend enforces deadline. Run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported. Playbook checks: bcrypt $2b$ OK, httpOnly cookie OK, CORS rejects unknown origin OK.
rca of the issue: Mobile overflow: Radix TabsList renders inline-flex with nowrap triggers; inside a CSS grid with a single implicit column, grid items default to min-width:auto so the column grows to the intrinsic width of the TabsList (~400px) exceeding the 390px viewport (minus padding) -> whole left column (card, dues) also widens to 410px.
